description: Use when you need official Bank of Korea statistics (base rate, money supply, key indicators) as a time series. Input: stat (ECOS table code, e.g. 722Y001), cycle (A/S/Q/M/SM/D), start, end (period format of cycle), optional item (e.g. 0101000). Output: JSON series with English labels, units, observations [{period,value}] (max 1,000 rows) and source attribution. Only BOK-authored tables are served. Example: ?stat=722Y001&cycle=M&start=202401&end=202412&item=0101000 Price: $0.0045 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

cycle.description: A annual, S semi-annual, Q quarterly, M monthly, SM semi-monthly, D daily

end.description: End period, same format as start

item.description: Item code 1 (e.g. 0101000). Optional item2..item4 also accepted.

start.description: Start period in ECOS format (A: YYYY, Q: YYYYQn, M: YYYYMM, D: YYYYMMDD)

stat.description: ECOS statistic table code, e.g. 722Y001 (base rate). Non-BOK tables → 403 (not charged).

name: kr_bok_ecos_series
title: Bank of Korea ECOS statistics (BOK-authored series only) with attribution
